Who made this app, and why

I\'m a hobbyist developer, and to be honest this app was put together with the help of Claude Code, because time is the thing I have least of.\n\nIt started as something for myself: I wanted to stop digging through web apps in the middle of a game and just be comfortable while playing.

The app grows in step with my own collection. I would rather add a campaign after playing it myself, so that I know the rules well enough to give players a good experience, than add one I have no experience with.\n\nFeel free to get in touch — I am glad to hear from you.

An unofficial fan-made app, free and not for sale. Not produced by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Marvel, Fantasy Flight Games or Asmodee. Marvel Champions: The Card Game and all related names and artwork belong to their respective owners. You need the physical game to play; this app does not replace the rules or the cards.
Card data comes from MarvelCDB, whose contributors maintain it. Thank you to them.

This app carries no advertising, and it never will. I turn down every advertising offer and sponsorship proposal I receive for it. It is free, it collects nothing about you, and it exists so that a game night runs a little more smoothly.
